newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Ossia unit acquires Taiwan company.
newsitem.headline: Ossia unit acquires Taiwan company.

text.p: Sporting goods and apparel dealer Ossia International Ltd said on Monday its subsidiary had acquired a wholesale and distribution business in Taiwan.
In a statement it said Ossia International (Taiwan) Co Ltd had signed an agreement to purchase K.M. Polo's distribution business K.M. Polo Enterprise Co Ltd, incorporated in Taiwan.
The sale took effect on April 1, and the consideration for the acquisition was NT $212 million (Singapore $10.8 million).
The purchase is subject to shareholders' approval and will be financed through internal sources and bank borrowings, it said.
